dashboard.label: Enterprise SOC - Linux Security Monitoring
dashboard.description: SOC monitoring dashboard for Linux authentication, SSH threats, sudo activity, and security detection alerts.

search.query: index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password") | eval status=if(match(_raw,"Failed password"),"Failed","Successful") | stats count by status
index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | timechart span=5m count AS failed_attempts

index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password") | rex field=_raw "(?:Failed|Accepted) password for (?:invalid user )?\S+ from (?<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})" | where isnotnull(src_ip) | stats count AS authentication_attempts by src_ip | sort - authentication_attempts | head 10
index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "pam_unix(sudo:auth)" "authentication failure" | timechart span=5m count AS sudo_failures

index=_audit action=alert_fired | rex field=_raw "ss_name=\"(?<alert_name>[^\"]+)\"" | rex field=_raw "severity=(?<severity_number>\d+)" | where like(alert_name,"SOC%") | eval severity=case( severity_number="5","Critical", severity_number="4","High", severity_number="3","Medium", severity_number="2","Low", true(),"Unknown" ) | table _time alert_name severity user | sort 0 -_time

index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password" OR "sudo:") | eval event_type=case( match(_raw,"Failed password"),"SSH Login Failed", match(_raw,"Accepted password"),"SSH Login Successful", match(_raw,"authentication failure"),"Sudo Authentication Failed", match(_raw,"COMMAND="),"Sudo Command", true(),"Other Sudo Event" ) | table _time host event_type _raw | sort 0 -_time | head 20
